reference: Watkins, van der Marel, Bellini & Anderson (2015), ApJ 812,149, Table 2
scale_method: HST proper-motion and literature line-of-sight velocity-dispersion dynamical distance
scale_assumptions: Spherical, isotropic, nonrotating constant mass-to-light dynamical model; reported statistical errors do not guarantee absence of dynamical systematics.
membership_source: Vasiliev & Baumgardt 2021 published Gaia EDR3 membership; membership is Gaia-conditioned, scale is not Gaia-parallax calibrated.
policy: Freeze photometric sample before membership association. Evaluate only after v3 method freeze and explicit identity/history audit. No predictions or reference-distance residuals used to choose sample.
